title: 6 security settings every GitHub maintainer should enable this week
GitHub Models is being fully retired on July 30, 2026
summary: In June, we announced that we are retiring GitHub Models and closed it to new customers.[^c-b8d27a833f]

title: Copilot CLI auto model selection routes based on task
summary: GitHub Copilot auto model selection now routes to the best model for your task in Copilot CLI, using utilization and model health metrics for a high quality, reliable, and token-efficient experience.[^c-d93139508a]

title: Browser tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code are generally available
summary: Browser tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code are now generally available.[^c-cd3044f794] Agents can now drive a real browser, navigate live web apps, and feed what they find back into the chat.[^c-f80fc04da1] Browser tools are on by default with general availability, shaped by feedback from preview users.[^c-08c8744356]

title: Set AI credit session limits in Copilot CLI and SDK
summary: You can now set AI credit session limits in Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot SDK to cap the amount an agent spends in a session.[^c-38a3e885c4]

title: Copilot vision is generally available
summary: Copilot vision is now generally available.[^c-fb25dd4377] You can attach images and PDFs directly to your chat prompts so Copilot can reason about what it sees alongside your code.[^c-733a5506a2]

title: New C++ language server config skill for Copilot CLI
summary: The Microsoft C++ Language Server is now available as a plugin on the Copilot Plugins marketplace.[^c-1a6648838d]

title: Secret scanning public monitoring for enterprises
summary: GitHub is committed to empowering the developer community by helping organizations recognize and address the risks of secret leaks wherever they happen.[^c-c84034f092]

title: Secret scanning adds validators for Asana, IBM, and MessageBird
summary: Secret scanning now runs validity checks on Asana, IBM, and MessageBird secrets so you can tell whether a leaked credential is still active.[^c-66648c1d69]

title: Enterprise managed-settings.json is generally available
summary: GitHub Enterprise Cloud customers can configure AI standards through a managed-settings.json file maintained in a .github-private repository in a selected organization.[^c-95b36671ac]

title: Enterprises can default to auto model selection
summary: Enterprise administrators can now set model to auto in the enterprise managed-settings.json to make Copilot auto model selection the default for new conversations.[^c-b344bee96e] Add auto to .github-private/.github/copilot/managed-settings.json in your source organization for enterprise governance so new conversations start with Copilot auto model selection by default.[^c-ef60fd8e29] Users can still switch to a different model on a per-conversation basis.[^c-ab8d08e4c8]

title: Can agents be proud of their work?
Agents window (Preview)
summary: The Agents window is a dedicated companion window optimized for exploring, iterating on, and reviewing agent sessions across projects and machines.[^c-681dff6ad2]

title: Troubleshoot agent behavior with /troubleshoot
summary: The troubleshoot skill, invoked with the /troubleshoot command, helps diagnose chat issues by analyzing chat session logs and surfacing insights into the agent's behavior.[^c-763f9a331a] Use it to investigate why custom instructions are ignored or why responses are slow.[^c-0786ae4894] In this release, you can use /troubleshoot to diagnose agent host sessions, including local and remote sessions.[^c-2a44a227ee]

title: Subagent credits
summary: When an agent delegates work to a subagent, it can be difficult to know the cost of the delegated work.[^c-eaa0ed86fd] To make this more transparent, you can now hover over a subagent section in the chat response to see the AI credits used by that subagent.[^c-c5370bebdc]

title: Sandboxing for terminal commands on macOS and Linux
summary: Approving every agent-invoked terminal command quickly becomes tedious.[^c-5de4bd60d3] Starting with this release, we're rolling out sandboxing for terminal commands on macOS and Linux: commands run with network access blocked and filesystem access restricted, letting the agent work with fewer prompts.[^c-6d18c3c0ac] The agent only asks for approval when a command needs to elevate and run outside the sandbox.[^c-ba0bf20bcf]

title: Deprecation of the built-in Ollama provider
summary: Model providers can contribute models for the VS Code chat experience via an extension.[^c-780fc6b4ed] By using an extension, providers can give you faster support for new models and capabilities than a built-in provider could offer.[^c-8ad420abc8]

title: Camera, location, devices, and more
summary: The integrated browser now supports per-site permissions.[^c-c98b724d37]

title: How GitHub used secret scanning to reach inbox zero
summary: GitHub had 20,000+ secret scanning alerts across 15,000 repositories.[^c-2b9cfa456f]

title: Cost centers now support AI credit pools
summary: You can now cap how much of your enterprise’s monthly included AI credits a cost center can use.[^c-66dd715aa4]

title: Issue fields are now generally available
summary: Issue fields are now generally available for all GitHub organizations on Free, Team, Enterprise, and GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency plans and will ship in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23.[^c-4f8cd95b29] Issue fields bring structured, typed metadata to issues, making it easy to track priority, effort, dates, and custom values consistently across your organization.[^c-b64dc6c841]

title: Copilot agent session streaming is now in public preview
Copilot CLI no longer needs a personal access token in GitHub Actions
Upcoming deprecation of Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash
Improved accuracy and coverage in Copilot usage metrics reports
Realtime multiplayer, automation, and you!
summary: How agentic workflows can automate code while keeping planning and collaboration multiplayer, with demos of secure GitHub Copilot automations and Ace, GitHub Next’s shared workspace for people and coding agents.[^c-dfe74200aa]

title: How Prompt Tuning Improved GPT-5.5 in VS Code
Q1 2026 Innovation Graph update: Open source collaboration is accelerating worldwide
summary: New Innovation Graph data shows global developer communities growing faster than ever, with collaboration reaching new highs across many economies.[^c-886c61adc1] Q1 2026 was a banner quarter for open source collaboration, as shown by the GitHub Innovation Graph’s economy collaborators metric, part of the latest data release.[^c-2265431770]

title: GitHub Copilot app available to all
summary: The GitHub Copilot app is now available on every Copilot plan.[^c-d9cadde358] Sign in with your GitHub account to start agent-driven development from your desktop.[^c-03af81d2c2] Available on macOS, Windows, and Linux platforms.[^c-9a0111445e]

title: Restrict who can dismiss reviews in rulesets
summary: You can now restrict who can dismiss pull request reviews directly in GitHub repository rulesets.[^c-7cd8c2cf96]

title: Copilot Billing Preview app will be retired on August 3
summary: The Copilot Billing Preview app will be retired on August 3, 2026.[^c-29363ddf6a] If you use it to review your GitHub Copilot spend, you can get even greater visibility directly in your GitHub billing settings.[^c-e23784c60a] The app was built to help you understand your bill as Copilot moved to usage-based billing.[^c-8e2dc08ac2]

title: Secret scanning extended metadata and multipart validation
Per-user budgets for cost centers in the billing UI
summary: Enterprise admins can now create cost center user-level budgets directly in the billing UI where you manage cost centers and budgets.[^c-40737d653e]

title: Kimi K2.7 now available for Copilot Business and Enterprise
Codex as agent provider and agentic enhancements in JetBrains IDEs
Add review cycles and time to adoption phases in the usage API
summary: The Copilot usage metrics API now reports two additional code-review velocity metrics for each AI adoption phase, extending the adoption phase cohorts fields available in the enterprise and organization reports.[^c-ee7ea8cca4] Alongside the existing per-phase merge time and merge counts, you can now compare how quickly pull requests are reviewed and how many review cycles they take across your adoption cohorts.[^c-3787ec8bfc]

title: Automating cross-repo documentation with GitHub Agentic Workflows
summary: Explore how the Aspire team turns merged product changes into SME-reviewed docs pull requests, closing the gap between release and documentation.[^c-eea0540ba6] “Where are the docs?” It’s a question nobody on a product team enjoys answering.[^c-690f29a92c] The honest reply is usually some variant of “behind.” A writer is staring at a closed pull request, trying to reverse-engineer what changed.[^c-9f17ac7068]

title: How GitHub Copilot enables zero DNS configuration for GitHub Pages
summary: Go from an empty repository to a live custom domain with HTTPS in about 14 minutes, without manually editing a single DNS record.[^c-a9b71c89bd] Custom domains make a project feel real.[^c-e2f20eb7dd] But for many developers, DNS, the last mile, is also the most frustrating: A records, CNAME entries, TTLs, and that long wait where you’re never quite sure if the internet is broken or you are.[^c-9fa34dcebc]

title: GitHub availability report: June 2026
summary: In June, we experienced six incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services.[^c-15794a9273] Last month, we added a new section to our monthly reports with updates on GitHub’s availability work and the infrastructure investments behind it.[^c-c39c6002ba] The response and the questions we heard made one thing clear: customers want more of this, not less—including when the news is mixed.[^c-e88bea6a88]

title: npm install-time security and GAT bypass2fa deprecation
Innersource security advisories are generally available
summary: GitHub Advanced Security enterprise customers can now publish internal security advisories.[^c-387bf0376c] Innersource advisories work similarly to GitHub’s open source advisories, but their visibility is restricted to repositories owned by the enterprise.[^c-51fdc305b6] There is a new REST API endpoint to manage innersource vulnerabilities, including operations to create, update, or withdraw vulnerabilities.[^c-7e72052eb9]

title: GitHub Mobile: Live notifications for Copilot CLI sessions
summary: Live coding agent notifications on GitHub Mobile now support remote Copilot CLI sessions, making it easier to stay connected to agent work that starts outside of GitHub Mobile.[^c-c3683799cb] When a Copilot CLI session is running remotely, GitHub Mobile can surface real-time updates directly on your phone so you can track progress, know when the agent needs your input, and jump back into the session when needed.[^c-4877f3e197]

title: GitHub Mobile: Fix merge conflicts with Copilot cloud agent
summary: GitHub Mobile now supports fixing pull request merge conflicts with Copilot cloud agent, making it easier to unblock pull requests while you’re on the go.[^c-1c4331e114] When a pull request has merge conflicts, you can now start the Copilot workflow directly from the pull request merge box on mobile.[^c-8c76cf3306] Tap Fix with Copilot to prepopulate a comment asking Copilot to resolve the conflicts, then submit it to launch Copilot cloud agent.[^c-b9f7d74a4f]

title: setup-java v5.5.0: signature verification, Kona JDK, and Maven fixes
summary: The actions/setup-java v5.5.0 release adds cryptographic signature verification for downloaded JDKs, support for a new distribution, and several quality-of-life improvements for Maven users.[^c-a2cb75f675]

title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code, June 2026 releases
Deploy managed Copilot settings via MDM in VS Code and CLI
summary: Enterprise administrators can now deliver managed GitHub Copilot settings directly to devices through native mobile device management (MDM) and file-based configuration, in addition to the existing server-managed channel.[^c-0444abff89]

title: Enterprise-managed OpenTelemetry export for VS Code and CLI
summary: Organizations can now mandate where GitHub Copilot sends OpenTelemetry (OTel) data, so telemetry flows to an approved collector without each developer setting OTEL_* environment variables.[^c-4d1497fc8a] The configuration is delivered through the telemetry block in enterprise-managed settings and applies to both the Copilot Chat extension in VS Code and the agent host process that powers Copilot CLI.[^c-6fd6846ee1]

title: Multiple chats in a session now supports Claude agent
summary: Claude agent-host sessions in the Agents window provide agentic coding capabilities powered by Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK directly in VS Code.[^c-4512942998] Multiple chats keep related conversation threads in one session instead of spreading them across separate top-level sessions.[^c-dd070c981d] Single-chat Claude sessions remain a focused way to work with the agent.[^c-e35a3bde65]

title: Chat without a selected workspace in the Agents window
summary: The Agents window gives you a dedicated place to create, resume, and manage agent sessions.[^c-970c6a585a] For project work, those sessions keep the chat, files, and changes together with the workspace.[^c-35c04334ef] For questions not tied to a folder, you can now start a chat in the Agents window without selecting a workspace.[^c-46194a7b9e]

title: Read-only subagent chats in the Agents window (Preview)
summary: When an agent delegates work to subagents, you can follow each worker's progress without interrupting or steering it from the main conversation.[^c-03e036d8f7] The Agents window provides a dedicated space for agent-driven workflows across projects, with chat and sessions as the primary interface.[^c-d1e454dbf2]

title: Keyboard shortcuts for chats in the Agents window
summary: The Agents window supports multi-chat sessions, where one agent session can contain multiple related chats.[^c-a0f0dc897a]

title: BYOK models in agent host Copilot sessions (Experimental)
Configure sampling parameters for custom endpoint models
Configure the default utility model for BYOK
summary: When you use a bring your own key (BYOK) model as the main agent model, you can change the default behavior used by built-in utility flows, such as generating a chat title or a commit message.[^c-3bf0f326f5]

title: Deep links to a specific chat
summary: The Agents window helps you manage agent sessions and return to their associated workspaces and chats.[^c-2e471b3474] Deep links can take you directly back to the relevant chat, so you don't have to open the workspace first and then manually find the session in Chat.[^c-dc0a5be701] When an app opens a vscode:// deep link for a session, VS Code opens the workspace and focuses the specific chat identified by the link's session query parameter.[^c-a20a9b2ae7]

title: Configurable placement of integrated browser tabs
summary: Keeping tabs organized can be a challenge.[^c-b50881d408]

title: OS-level keyboard shortcuts
summary: VS Code can now contribute OS-level keyboard shortcuts.[^c-ccf0c4efa6]

title: How GitHub gave every repository a durable owner
Ask Copilot for a repository overview
summary: You can now ask GitHub Copilot for a high-level overview of any repository you’re exploring for the first time.[^c-964f3cb807] When you visit the home page of a repository you haven’t contributed to before on github.com, Copilot offers to generate an overview for you.[^c-c8f7cdcfad]

title: Organization-level targeting for GitHub Code Quality
summary: Organization owners can now target a subset of repositories when enabling or disabling GitHub Code Quality, rather than applying it to every repository at once.[^c-2e71345d40]

title: OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna are now available in GitHub Copilot
summary: OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 family is now rolling out in GitHub Copilot.[^c-e886578aab] GPT-5.6 comes in three variants, Sol, Terra, and Luna, so you can match the model to the job, whether that’s reasoning over a large codebase, everyday agentic coding, or fast, cost-efficient assistance.[^c-9e670b092b]

title: New pull requests dashboard is now generally available
